note: This governance's fragment of the promulgation boundary — composed with the harness base declaration and every other activated governance's fragment at sync time (Plan-033, ADR-0019). Read, never re-decided at a call site. One package, two units (Plan-040 Track 3, ADR-0020): a repository binding only `log` composes only the `log` entries in practice — `learning` activates nowhere by default, so its entries below contribute nothing until a repository declares `types.learning` itself.

paths.why: Each declares its own version and each version jump has a migration note. This is the class's clearest case: drift here is what the applied-version map exists to detect.

Two owners, permanently (Plan-031): the tooling owns the structure — migration may restructure per a recorded note, and the template-version gates read the declared stamp — while the repository owns every word written under it. Promulgation still never writes here; `shaped` is migration's class, not promulgation's.
Same clearest case as the log template: it declares its own version and each version jump has a migration note.

The same two-owner rule as project/log/** (Plan-031): the tooling owns the structure, the repository owns every word. Reached only by a repository that has activated `learning` itself — most have not, this one included.
